title: a child SpecialJoinInfo frees relid sets the parent still owns
live_proof: inspection at the 17.0 pin: build_child_join_sjinfo (src/backend/optimizer/path/joinrels.c:1693) shallow-copies the parent at :1710, so every Relids pointer is shared, and adjust_child_relids (src/backend/optimizer/util/appendinfo.c:554) copies ONLY when a member changes -- :566-568 -- and otherwise returns the parent's set unchanged at :580. free_child_join_sjinfo:1755-1758 then bms_free's those four fields unconditionally. The pre-fix shape is present.
object: a relids Bitmapset shared between parent and child
lifetime_ender: free_child_join_sjinfo frees it unconditionally, once per partition pair

cheribsd-revocation.oracle: completes with no capability fault; the case's own PG_DEFECT probe prints twice, so the defective sequence provably executed -- REACHED-SILENT (2026-10-05, plain purecap, revocation=1 every_free=0). A use-after-free between two palloc chunks never crosses a malloc boundary, so there is nothing for a malloc-granular revoker to reclaim.
